items.title: McNeal Breaux Interview, 1958-11-24
items.q: Yeah, I played a job with him. I know he played a lot of tuba already.

ctx.x: Yeah, he had, no, he had, uh, he had put his, the tube up and he played bass with the, the, the, the Nola band. Oh, yeah? With Pila Kass.
I didn't like that. I didn't know that. Yeah, I played a job with him. I know he played a lot of tuba already.
Yeah, I played a lot of job with him with his bass plowing. He used to read pretty nicely. Yeah? What kind of tuba would he have?
